invalidFieldSuggestion: Unknown or unusable field `{field}`. Did you mean `{suggestion}`?
blockTypeRequired: A `has` on the blocks field `{field}` must name its type with a bare `block` equality
unknownBlockTypeSuggestion: Unknown block type `{block}`. Did you mean `{suggestion}`?
nullEquality: `null` is not a value; use `isNull` to match a null field
invalidPagination: Use `limit` and `offset`, or `page` and `perPage`, but not both
emptySelect: `select` must name at least one field
duplicateOrderField: Field `{field}` is ordered more than once
localeNotApplicable: This collection has no translatable content
tooManyConditions: The `where` condition has too many clauses (max `{max}`)
tooManyBoundParams: The `where` condition binds too many values (max `{max}`)
valueTooLarge: A value is too large (max `{max}` bytes)
patternTooLarge: A pattern is too large (max `{max}` bytes)
